$comment_history: Prior to the Linear-based dev-governance migration this registry carried five platform-specific prefixes (agent/**, orchestrator/**, cursor/**, copilot/**, claude/**) for a multi-cloud-agent dispatch model. That model is retired; all locally-dispatched agent work now uses a single agent/** prefix regardless of worker binary. See docs/operators/local-execution.md and docs/governance/linear-information-architecture.md.
